note: Triennial election of the sixteen electoral divisions of Clogher rural district, one member each; Tyrone's polling day was Thursday 2 June 1955, but no poll was needed. The Returning Officer's 'Notice of Result of Elections', dated 31 May 1955 and signed by John F. McCrea, Returning Officer (Impartial Reporter and Farmers' Journal, 9 June 1955, p. 7), declares that the persons named in column 5 were duly elected for the divisions opposite, no polls having been taken; it names a member for all sixteen divisions and has no column of retiring members deemed re-elected. The Strabane Chronicle (21 May 1955, p. 1) reported no contests for any of the county's six rural councils. No party labels are printed in the notice and none is recorded. Returned unopposed.
